label: Marketing
description: Promoting rather than closing a sale: campaign or offer enquiries, follow-ups on downloaded content or sign-ups, event and webinar invitations, surveys, advertising enquiries.

intents.name: lead_follow_up
intents.description: Following up with someone who downloaded content, signed up or showed interest.
intents.guidance: Remind them what they showed interest in, ask what prompted it, and qualify the need with one question.

intents.name: campaign_inquiry
intents.description: The customer asks about an offer, promotion or campaign they saw.
intents.guidance: Ask where they saw it and explain the offer only as it was stated; ask which part interests them.

intents.name: event_invitation
intents.description: Inviting to, or discussing, a webinar, demo day or event.
intents.guidance: Give the date and the one benefit most relevant to them, then ask if they want to be registered.

intents.name: advertising_inquiry
intents.description: The customer asks about advertising, sponsorship or promoting their business.
intents.guidance: Ask about their goal, audience and budget before suggesting a package.

intents.name: feedback_survey
intents.description: Collecting opinions about a product, brand or campaign.
intents.guidance: Ask one short, neutral question at a time and thank them for each answer; do not lead the answer.

intents.name: not_interested
intents.description: The person says they are not interested, busy, or asks not to be contacted.
intents.guidance: Respect it: offer to update their contact preferences and end politely. Do not push.

intents.name: general
intents.description: Anything else: greetings, small talk or unclear lines.
intents.guidance: Suggest the next useful question that finds out what the person is interested in.

facts.description: Product, offer or topic they are interested in
Where they heard about it: ad, email, event or referral
Who they want to reach, for advertising
Preferred channel and time to be contacted
